name: support-tone-compliance
description: Rubric for customer-support reply tasks — does the reply resolve the issue accurately, in the right tone, while following policy (no forbidden promises, disclosures, or tone breaks)?

content.summary: Score the support reply on resolution accuracy, tone/register, policy compliance, and completeness of the answer — a compliant reply that doesn't help still fails, and a helpful reply that breaks policy fails harder.

dimensions.name: resolution_accuracy
dimensions.title: Resolution accuracy
dimensions.description: Does the reply correctly address the customer's actual issue with accurate product/policy facts? Wrong answers and confident guesses score near zero.

dimensions.name: tone
dimensions.title: Tone
dimensions.description: Is the register professional, empathetic, and appropriate to the customer's mood and the brand voice? Hostile, dismissive, or robotically generic replies score lower.

dimensions.name: policy_compliance
dimensions.title: Policy compliance
dimensions.description: Does the reply obey the stated support policies — no forbidden refunds/promises, required disclaimers present, correct escalation, no data leaks?

dimensions.name: completeness
dimensions.title: Completeness
dimensions.description: Does the reply cover every question or action item the customer raised, including next steps? Partial answers score proportionally.

criteria.text: Example criterion — the generator replaces these with task-specific checkable items (policy rules, required disclosures, must-answer questions).
